problem.title: Split String into Descending Consecutive Values
problem.problemStatement: Given a numeric string, determine whether it can be split into two or more non-empty substrings such that the numeric values are in strictly descending consecutive order.
problem.input: • First line contains a numeric string.
problem.output: Print YES if such a split exists; otherwise print NO.
